carrot_cut.derivation: (67.59 N /31 mm)*35 mm; multiply2 for specimen/blade variation
carrot_cut.scope: internal powered blade; isolated arm0 N
carrot_cut.limitations: Width scaling is a sizing approximation; use20–40 mm/min in initial trials. No credit for faster draw action.

potato_cut.scope: internal powered blade; isolated arm0 N
potato_cut.limitations: 70 mm maximum transverse chord; source specimen smaller; recalibrate before faster speeds.

greens_cut.derivation: Carrot-envelope surrogate(67.59/31 N/mm)*total simultaneously engaged width<=80 mm; multiply2
greens_cut.scope: internal powered blade; isolated arm0 N
greens_cut.limitations: Not measured bok-choy resistance. Conservative tissue proxy, not a statistical bound; no claim of proven sharp-edge quality.

tomato_wedge.derivation: Compression proxy sigma=15 N/(pi*2^2 mm2); four diametral blades total280 mm,thickness.952 mm;F=sigma*280*.952; multiply2
tomato_wedge.scope: internal powered blade; isolated arm0 N
tomato_wedge.limitations: Penetration stress used as conservative effective cutting stress; not a wedger measurement or permission to press this force into fruit. Skin rupture/quality require measured cartridge force-displacement trials.

peel_drag.derivation: 1.68 N/mm*maximum25 mm engaged peel ribbon; multiply1.5
peel_drag.scope: R tool; fixture takes food reaction
peel_drag.limitations: Carrot-source proxy also sizes potato. No assertion that potato eyes use the same process; curved coverage inspected and repeated.

peel_normal.derivation: k=1000 N/m calibrated spring; deflection5 mm; F=k*delta; multiply1.5
peel_normal.limitations: Spring preload/design assumptions, not existing product measurement; hard stop and load cell calibration required.

eye_core.derivation: Carrot structural envelope per blade width*12 mm eye/core cutter perimeter engagement; multiply2
eye_core.limitations: Root proxy for localized eyes and tomato stem tissue; not measured scoop torque. Thin slicing10 mm maximum lever gives screen torque0.523 Nm. Depth stop2 mm potato,8 mm tomato.

root_rub.derivation: k=1000 N/m*6 mm pad deflection; multiply1.5
root_rub.limitations: Springs calibrated; visible-clean endpoint controls repetition, not force escalation.

leaf_rub.derivation: k=400 N/m*5 mm pad deflection; multiply1.5
leaf_rub.scope: L pad; stalk supported in sink insert
leaf_rub.limitations: Nominal2 N is bottom of inherited2–5 N cleaning band; crease inspection mandatory.

tomato_rub.derivation: k=200 N/m*5 mm pad deflection; multiply1.5
tomato_rub.scope: L pad; tomato supported in cup
tomato_rub.limitations: Not a universal bruise threshold. Reject visible damage or>=10%compression.

water_jet.derivation: Water1000 kg/m3; flow6 L/min through10 mm diameter outlet; F=rho*Q^2/A; multiply1.5
water_jet.limitations: Declared flowcap, not measured faucet specification. Add to brush force in worst direction.

drawer_insert.derivation: mu_slide.5*loadedcassette1.1kg*g +1.1kg*.3m/s2 +2N latch spring; multiply1.5; CAD bare rootcassette.639kg plus key/retention/boughtfittings budgeted.90kg
drawer_insert.limitations: Conservative coefficient0.5; 0.21 dry published value not used for wet sliding. Hard-stop/jam detection; not servo saturation force.

handle_carry.derivation: Maximumwetcolander1.0kg*acceleration.3m/s2; multiply1.5; gravity separate. Per-pose actualmass is used for carry vectors.
handle_carry.limitations: Payload masses budgeted from geometry plus produce. Full3 kg carry check is additional arm-team requirement.

leaf_separate.derivation: .1 kg loose trimmed greens*acceleration.3; multiply1.5; gravity separate
leaf_separate.limitations: Only fully detached leaves; never budget attachment tearing as inertia. If resistance remains, return to guarded root trim.

cleanup_wipe.derivation: k500 N/m*5 mm pad deflection; multiply1.5
cleanup_wipe.limitations: No exposed-blade wipe; isolate drives and use guards/cassette cover.

machine_index.derivation: mu_slide.5*loadedmovingtray1.1kg*g +1.1kg*.3m/s2; multiply1.5. Feed pauses during blade engagement; no cutting side force credited to index motor.
